title: Binance Adds FDUSD & More Pairs on Cross Margin and Isolated Margin
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance has added   FDUSD  as a new  borrowable asset  on  Cross   Margin  and  Isolated Margin,   as well as new margin pairs   on  Cross   Margin  and  Isolated Margin . New Cross Margin Pairs:   BTC/FDUSD ,  ETH/FDUSD ,  FDUSD/USDT ,  YGG/BTC New Isolated Margin Pairs:  BTC/FDUSD ,  ETH/FDUSD ,  FDUSD/USDT ,  OP/BTC Explore Binance Margin Now! Notes: Please refer to  Margin Data  for a list of the most updated marginable assets and further information on specific limits, collateral ratio and rates. Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Further Information: Margin Trading Overview How to Use Short on Margin Trading How to Use Long on Margin Trading Thanks for your support! Binance Team 2023-08-09
